title: Enhanced irradiation-resistance in NbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy via rhenium addition.

recollection.intervention: Addition of rhenium to the alloy
recollection.structure: Likely a modified high-entropy alloy with rhenium incorporated
recollection.mechanism: Possibly improved defect recombination or suppression of radiation-induced damage due to rhenium's influence on atomic-scale interactions
recollection.results: Likely enhanced irradiation resistance, potentially quantified by reduced defect density or improved mechanical properties under irradiation conditions

score.note: The recollection identifies Re addition, but only at the level already stated in the title. It gives no specific structural changes such as grain refinement, lattice distortion, excess free volume, amorphous grain-boundary regions, or suppressed grain-boundary He bubbles. Defect recombination is directionally consistent with the proposed mechanism but remains generic and speculative. No quantitative irradiation conditions or mechanical-property values are recalled.
